title: Training #4 — TP-26 Federated SAR and Water Observation Track
purpose: Use the TP-26 Global Virtual Constellation as a legal/public multi-provider routing and validation layer for SAR, hydrology and water-observation training. The goal is architecture improvement and cross-sensor generalization, not provider ranking.

tp26_role.principle: TP-26 is a virtual federation of observation sources and processing routes. It is not a claim that Terraforming Planet owns, controls or partners with the listed satellites, agencies or companies.

sources: ESA/European Commission Copernicus Sentinel-1 through CDSE
NASA JPL OPERA RTC-S1 derived from Sentinel-1
NASA JPL OPERA DSWx-S1 for validated dynamic surface-water extent where applicable
roles: reference product for water classification where DSWx-S1 is valid
guardrails: Do not call rendered preview luma calibrated sigma0/gamma0.
Do not infer water depth or hydrological cause from SAR intensity alone.
Do not claim paleochannel ground truth without independently verified labels.

sources: JAXA JERS-1 SAR global mosaics where officially released
roles: cross-frequency generalization check against Sentinel-1 C-band
sar_l_band.default_data_policy: Prefer JAXA officially released free global mosaics/high-level research products. Do not assume unrestricted access to standard PALSAR-3 or other account/proposal-gated products.
guardrails: Preserve JAXA/METI attribution and terms of use.
Do not redistribute source products contrary to their licence.
Keep acquisition-date metadata because annual mosaics are not temporal averages unless the source states otherwise.

sources: INPE Brazil Data Cube / CBERS / Amazonia-1 where applicable
NASA GPM where available through CMR
NOAA/GEBCO bathymetry and multibeam metadata for coastal/ocean context
guardrails: SWOT water-surface elevation is not bathymetry by itself.
GRACE/GRACE-FO is regional and must not be used to locate a small aquifer.
SMAP does not provide local subsurface fracture/aquifer maps.
NOAA multibeam sonar is an in-situ/shipborne acoustic source, not SAR and not a satellite replacement.

active_or_public_first.use: Sentinel-1/2/3 discovery, metadata and selected public/authorized product access
RTC-S1 and DSWx-S1 products plus CMR/GIBS discovery/streaming
long optical record and independent historical context
official free PALSAR/PALSAR-2/JERS-1 global SAR mosaics for L-band diversity
federated discovery and interoperability reference; not treated as one sensor
weather/ocean/bathymetry context and multibeam source registry

conditional_authorized_only.provider: CSA / NRCan RADARSAT Constellation Mission / RADARSAT-2
conditional_authorized_only.rule: Use only after authentication/licence terms are verified for the specific research product.
Use only after official product access and redistribution terms are verified.
Use only through an allowed public/research/proposal path.
Use only through an allowed account/proposal/research path.
Use only under an explicit authorized/commercial/research licence.

conditional_authorized_only.provider: ICEYE / Capella / other commercial SAR providers
conditional_authorized_only.rule: Never use by default. Integrate only under an explicit research, disaster-response or commercial licence and keep all licensed assets outside the public repository unless redistribution is expressly permitted.

dataset_design.note: Percentages are initial sampling targets, not quotas. The builder must reduce/skip a source when licence, quality, coverage, temporal comparability or rate-limit rules require it.

evidence_package_for_agents: deterministic pixel/area/backscatter-derived metrics only when scientifically valid
agent_question: Given this multi-provider TP-26 evidence package, what can be concluded, what remains unknown, which independent observation should be requested next, and what would falsify the current hypothesis?
agent_systems: EVE-Instruct through official hosted API if available, otherwise an official eve-esa checkpoint on ephemeral cloud GPU
learning_goal: Generate architecture lessons for a better planetary-observation system: provider routing, sensor complementarity, failure recovery, uncertainty, provenance, cross-sensor validation and missing-observation detection.
not_goals: declaring Terra or EVE globally superior
inventing environmental ground truth from training loss
acceptance_gates: Every used asset has provider, product ID, acquisition time/coverage and licence/access provenance.
Sentinel-1 C-band and at least one independent JAXA L-band public product are represented in the full run if operationally available.
DSWx-S1 is treated as a validated NASA water product, not universal ground truth for every hydrological question.
Restricted/commercial TP-26 providers remain disabled unless explicit authorization is recorded.
No benchmark B01-B10 samples enter training.
Cross-provider/geography/time holdouts remain untouched until evaluation.
All regressions and source failures are reported.
